description: List the departments/areas (Tätigkeitsbereiche) of the company as id and name. Surveys segment results by these areas. Read-only. Call it before safe_mind_create_department or safe_mind_create_survey to reuse existing names exactly. Requires an API key: set SAFE_MIND_API_KEY or call safe_mind_get_api_key first. Acts on the company of the account behind the key.
name: safe_mind_list_departments
